title: no-iou-stands
intention: No IOU stands anywhere in the system: every rule written down as owed is either already enforced (its IOU prose deleted, the enforcing address cited) or is a BUILDME-ready ticket, and a sieve reds the word in class-space.
why: Akien, idea 2026-09-09-agreed-and-we-should-scrub-all-ious: "agreed. and we should scrub all IOUs into BUILDME ready tickets"; and on 2026-09-29, reviewing it: "THIS HAS BEEN ANSWERED REPEATEDLY / THERE ARE TO BE NO IOUS EVER". An IOU is a rule resting as policy (Law 4), and asking him again is re-deriving the settled (Law 1). Measured 2026-09-29: 93 git-tracked class-space files carry the word.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics); Law 1 (answered repeatedly).
how: Census every IOU site; per site measure whether the named physics exists (stale → delete the prose, cite the enforcing address) or find/cast the ticket that builds it and rehearse it clean. A build_inspector sieve reds the word IOU in git-tracked class-space. CLAUDE.md and Law 4 wording go to Akien as questions on this ticket. ec9c476508dc is disposed superseded.

falsifier.proves_green: GREEN when `git grep -w IOU` in class-space returns only the sieve's own definition, every removed site is accounted for in the census (enforcing address that resolves, or ticket id rehearsed clean), and the sieve reds a planted IOU.
falsifier.wrong_intent: WRONG INTENT if the word is gone but the same sites say 'owed', 'not yet enforced', 'awaiting physics' or 'debt' — the renamed resting state, measured by grepping those at the census sites.

decisions.text: D1 THE CENSUS: `git grep -n -w IOU` over the cairn repo (93 files, measured 2026-09-29). Written to cairn/machines/build_inspector/iou_census.json through the artifact door, one row per site: {path, line, text, rule, disposition, evidence}. disposition is one of 'enforced' (evidence = the enforcing address, a sieve name or file:line that resolves), 'ticket' (evidence = a ticket id), 'question' (evidence = an open-<id> bound to this ticket), 'not-an-iou' (evidence = why: e.g. a proof tooth that asserts the word's absence).

D2 PER SITE: 'enforced' → delete the IOU prose in the same commit and cite the address in the census. 'ticket' → find an existing ticket first (grep CairnCommons/tickets for the rule), else cast one through /intent and /sorted; the site's prose is replaced by the ticket id. 'question' → Akien's text (CLAUDE.md, Law 4's 'tracked debt (an IOU)', MAP.md, press_office/) is never edited by CC: a question bound to this ticket proposes the rewrite verbatim.

D3 THE SIEVE: build_inspector gains 'no_iou_stands', reading `git grep -n -w IOU` over tracked files; allowlist is exactly the sieve's own module and its proof. It reds per site. Registered beside the other sieves in inspector.py.

D4 ec9c476508dc is dispositioned superseded by this ticket through the emit chokepoint's disposition branch (transitions.emit, is_disposition) as the first act of this ticket's BUILDME, citing this ticket id.

D5 THE PROOF: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_no_iou_stands.py, prove-first: a scratch git repo with one tracked file saying IOU and one not; teeth — (1) the sieve reds the planted file with its line; (2) greens after the word is removed; (3) the synonym check reports 'owed'/'not yet enforced'/'awaiting physics' at a census site. Every output marked testing.
D6 CHILDREN are cast from the census as it runs; this ticket reaches PROVEME when the census has no row without a disposition and the sieve is green.

RECORDS (CC, 2026-11-12): a door-written record (history.json, state.json, *.jsonl, validations/*.json) and a proof's frozen data fixture (intentions_model_compiler/probes/dated_append_judgments.json) quote what was said when, and are never edited (Law 7; history_integrity reds an in-place edit). Measured 2026-11-12: 13 such files carry the word. Each site is a census row, disposition 'not-an-iou', evidence 'record of truth'; the sieve reads authored files only and skips those names.

QUESTIONS (CC, 2026-11-12): D2's 'question' disposition is a [Q#n] at the outline's line (standing since 2026-11-08: questions go in the outline, cairn/press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt 0.2), not a bound open-<id>. Its census evidence is the Q number.

WHERE A RED LANDS (CC, 2026-11-12): a site inside a census row's directory reds on that row; a site outside every row (skills/, bin/, press_office/, CLAUDE.md, MAP.md, learning/) reds on build_inspector's row, the sieve's own home, so no site is unreported.

HAND-SET PROBE CONSTANTS (CC, 2026-11-12): 15 probe comments call a hand-set constant 'a learns-its-gates IOU'. 336a781018ba (PROVED) made every Threshold carry set_by, and cairn/tools/base/probe.py:273 refuses one without it; the outline holds no threshold mover. Each site is 'enforced' with evidence probe.py:273, and its comment says what is: hand-set, provenance declared in set_by. No owed debt is claimed in another word.

THE PROOF'S CLAUSES (CC, 2026-11-12): the falsifier carries proves_green, not proves_red, so it names no clause the proof can key to. Falsifier clause (1) is added by this line: the sieve reds a planted IOU in a tracked file, naming its line. Falsifier clause (2) is added by this line: it greens once the word is removed, and skips door-written records (D7). Falsifier clause (3) is added by this line: it reds a synonym (tracked debt, declared debt, not yet enforced, awaiting physics, ticket owed, owed to the ticket) in a file the census names, the falsifier's WRONG INTENT.

THE CENSUS IS A RECORD (CC, 2026-11-12): iou_census.json is written through the artifact door and quotes each site's old text, so it is a door-written record like D7's and the sieve skips it by name. Its rows name the file each synonym check reads (clause 3). The outline question for Akien's text (D8) names each site by file and line and quotes no flagged word, so the outline carries none.
